package.name: patrol_amr_safety
package.description:
AMR local safety, status and command-identity nodes.
Split out of patrol_amr on 2026-09-08. The two packages had been one directory that two people edited at the same time, so each side's work kept overwriting the other's. Separating along the ownership boundary that already existed removes the overlap: no file belongs to both. Both packages still build into one workspace and their nodes still talk over topics, exactly as before.
